name: Cyber Security Skills Partnership Innovation Fund — Round 2 (AU)
source: Department of Industry — Cyber Security Skills Partnership Innovation Fund Round 2, Grant opportunity guidelines July 2021 (provided by the customer 2026-09-07). Fund-specific traps per the customer's analysis: consortium required; government bodies may only be partners; the WGEA exclusion is conditional on headcount.

rules.title: Consortium REQUIRED: lead + at least 1 partner
rules.quote: Each application must be a joint application with a lead organisation, who is the main driver of the project and is eligible to apply, and at least one other project partner.

rules.title: Lead has an ABN + GST registration
rules.quote: To be eligible you must: have an Australian Business Number (ABN); be registered for the Goods and Services Tax (GST)

rules.title: Eligible entity type (incorporated in Australia)
rules.quote: and be one of the following entities: an entity incorporated in Australia; an incorporated association; an incorporated not for profit organisation

rules.title: Government bodies may NOT lead (partner only)
rules.quote: A state, territory or local government department is not eligible as the lead applicant, but may be a project partner in a joint application.

rules.title: Letter of support from EACH project partner
rules.quote: We can only accept applications: where you provide a letter from each of your project partners supporting the project

rules.title: Board/CEO endorses the project and commits the remaining funding
rules.quote: where you can certify that your board supports the project (or chief executive officer or equivalent if there is no board), and that you can complete the project and meet the costs of the project not covered by grant funding

rules.title: Eligible project expenditure ≥ $500,000
rules.quote: To be eligible your project must: include eligible activities and eligible expenditure; have at least $500,000 in eligible expenditure

rules.title: Not an excluded entity (individuals, unincorporated, WGEA non-compliance…)
rules.quote: You are not eligible to apply if you are: ... an employer of 100 or more employees that has not complied with the Workplace Gender Equality Act (2012); an individual; unincorporated association
